harness: a TTS reply (about 6.4 s) kept the sink busy, and the skip-if-busy check skipped the rest of the list in one pass
defects_found.fix: wait up to 20 s for an idle sink before each clip

defects_found.what: webcam (default source) clips at full scale on 12.6 Hz rumble: 86 % of its energy is below 45 Hz; about 3,400 clipped samples in 2 min
defects_found.fix: none in code; recommend the fifine as default input and a clipping warning in the UI

defects_found.what: worker stderr is discarded (Stdio null in the live supervisor): a worker crash reads only as restart_limit
defects_found.fix: not changed; recommended follow-up in src/live.rs with a test

recommendation.default_input_device: alsa_input.usb-MV-SILICON_fifine_Microphone_20190808-00.analog-stereo (fifine): clean, no clipping, speech band 39 %; the webcam is not suitable (rumble and clipping). Not changed; the owner decides.
recommendation.sensitivity: keep 1.0 (default). Loop: 0.5 8/10 and 1.5 8/10 with 0 false in 10 each; 1.0 22/30 with 0 false in 30. Not a rate on real acoustics.
recommendation.acoustic_pickup: NOT MEASURED. No mic heard the speakers at 90 %. Needs a speaker placed near the mic (or a headset) and a re-run of probe_ramp.py.
